## Patterns
| Keyword | Description | Example |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| `trusted-mode` | Most queries require trusted context to verify Platform proofs; use `EvoSDK.testnetTrusted()` | `const sdk = EvoSDK.testnetTrusted(); await sdk.connect();` |
| `WithProof-suffix` | Every query has a `*WithProof` variant returning `ProofMetadataResponseTyped<T>` with `{ data, proof, metadata }` | `const r = await sdk.identities.fetchWithProof(id); r.proof` |
| `map-response` | `sdk.documents.query()` and batch calls return `Map<string, T\|undefined>`; iterate with `Array.from(map.values()).filter(Boolean)` | `Array.from((await sdk.documents.query(q)).values()).filter(Boolean)` |
| `toJSON-conversion` | Raw `Document` objects expose `.toJSON()` to get a plain record; always call it before serialisation | `const plain = doc.toJSON?.() ?? doc` |
| `IdentitySigner` | State transitions need a signer; create `new IdentitySigner()` and call `signer.addKeyFromWif(wif)` | `const signer = new IdentitySigner(); signer.addKeyFromWif(wif);` |
| `WIF-private-key` | Private keys for signing are WIF strings; derive with `wallet.deriveKeyFromSeedPhrase()` or import with `wallet.keyPairFromWif()` | `const { privateKeyWif } = await wallet.deriveKeyFromSeedPhrase({ seedPhrase, network: 'testnet' })` |
| `asset-lock-proof` | Identity creation requires a Type-8 Core asset lock tx; build proof with `AssetLockProof.createInstantAssetLockProof(islockBytes, txBytes, 0)` | — |
| `devnet-non-trusted` | Non-trusted devnet requires explicit `addresses` and use `fetchUnproved` (no proof verification) | `EvoSDK.devnet('mynet', { addresses: ['https://10.0.0.5:1443'] })` |
| `devnet-trusted` | Trusted devnet pre-fetches quorums from `https://quorums.<name>.networks.dash.org`; override with `quorumUrl` | `EvoSDK.devnetTrusted('paloma', { quorumUrl: 'https://custom.quorums/' })` |
| `sdk-caching` | Cache one connected SDK per network; recreate only on transport errors (see dash-bridge `sdkCache` pattern) | `D:src/platform/client.ts` |
| `document-system-fields` | `$id`, `$ownerId`, `$createdAt`, `$updatedAt`, `$revision` are read-only system fields; never set them manually | — |
| `DPNS-contested` | Usernames 3–19 chars (after normalization) trigger contested registration; check with `sdk.dpns.isContestedUsername(label)` | — |
| `DPNS-homograph-safe` | Non-ASCII labels must be normalized with `sdk.dpns.convertToHomographSafe(label)` before checking availability | — |
| `bigint-credits` | All credit/balance amounts on Platform are `bigint`; do not mix with `number` arithmetic | `const amt = BigInt(100_000);` |
| `ESM-only` | `@dashevo/evo-sdk` is ESM-only (`"type": "module"`); use dynamic `import()` in CommonJS | — |
| `PlatformAddress-bech32m` | Platform addresses are bech32m strings (prefix `tdash1` testnet, `dash1` mainnet); derive from private key via `PlatformAddressSigner.addKey()` | — |
| `chainlock-fallback` | If IS-lock times out, build a `ChainAssetLockProof` once the tx confirms + is chain-locked | `D:src/types.ts` — `AssetLockProofData` discriminated union |
| `token-id-from-contract` | Token IDs are derived values; use `sdk.tokens.calculateId(contractId, position)` — never hard-code | — |
| `singleton-wasm-init` | Initialize WASM only once per app; use a singleton service to prevent duplicate `initWasmSdk()` calls | `Y:lib/services/evo-sdk-service.ts` |
| `retry-transport` | Wrap SDK calls with retry on transport errors; recommended settings: `retries:2, timeoutMs:40000, banFailedAddress:true` | `D:src/platform/client.ts` — `PLATFORM_REQUEST_SETTINGS` |
| `PoolingWasm-Standard` | Use `PoolingWasm.Standard` for pooling parameter when withdrawing from Platform addresses to Core | `P:js-evo-sdk/src/addresses/facade.ts` |
